question: In the channelized-intersection example in Figure 2A-3, how far from the nose of the island is the YIELD sign shown?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 2A-3 (Drawing B – Channelized intersection) does not dimension the YIELD sign from the nose of the channelizing island. The YIELD sign for the channelized turn roadway is shown with a lateral offset of "6 ft to 12 ft MIN." from the edge of the roadway, while the sign placed on the island itself is dimensioned "2 ft MIN." from the island edges. No island-nose-to-YIELD-sign distance is given in the figure or in the text evidence provided, so a specific nose distance cannot be stated. Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Drawing B of Figure 2A-3 shows the YIELD sign on the outside of the channelized turn lane labeled "6 ft to 12 ft MIN." lateral offset, and the island-mounted sign with "2 ft MIN." offsets from the island edges — no dimension is drawn from the island nose to the YIELD sign. - [Image 4] The full-page view of Figure 2A-3 confirms the same dimensions (6 ft to 12 ft MIN. lateral offset for the YIELD sign; 2 ft MIN. offsets only for the island-mounted sign), with the note that lateral offset is measured from the edge of the shoulder (6 ft) or edge of the traveled way (12 ft). Citations: - Figure 2A-3 (p.52) - Page 93
gold_answer: At least 2 feet from the nose of the island.
